pages.text: A hauler's burner needs heat to lift the cargo. You can launch a balloon with an $(2)Empty Hand$(), but the trip will be slow ($(2)x0.5 speed$()). If you are in a hurry, you can feed special fuels to the anchored balloon by right-clicking it.

pages.title: Standard Flight
pages.text: Using $(2)Coal$() or Dried Kelp heats the burner to normal operational levels, providing a standard flight speed multiplier of $(2)x1.0$().

pages.title: Fast Flight
pages.text: Using $(2)Blaze Powder$() or Magma Cream increases the heat significantly, granting a fast flight speed multiplier of $(2)x1.5$().

pages.title: Swift Flight
pages.text: Fueling the burner with nether energy from $(2)Soul Sand$() provides a powerful swift flight speed multiplier of $(2)x2.0$().

pages.title: Rocket Flight
pages.text: Using an explosive $(2)Wind Charge$() or Gunpowder turns the hauler into a rocket, granting the ultimate maximum speed multiplier of $(2)x3.0$().
